integrity: Explicit proof and reproducible exact rational finite checks supplied. Finite checks supplement but cannot replace the all-size theorem. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact law and stochastic order assume a finite loopless complete bipartite graph, independent per-step control offers and uniform uncontrolled transitions. Gaussian and square-root-window limits hold only at fixed positive control probability less than one. Historical priority and all external extensions remain unverified.
title: A square-root imbalance transition for optimally biased bipartite cover times
